# Rubble left where a house was hit: a few tilted dark blocks. Origin at the ground, up Z.
new
material new Rubble --base-color 0.310 0.078 0.275 --no-slot
material new Ember --base-color 0.435 0.114 0.361 --emission 0.435 0.114 0.361 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name R0 --size 1 --location -0.12 0 0.06
scale 0.2 0.22 0.12
apply --scale
set rotation 0 18 0
add mesh cube --name R1 --size 1 --location 0.1 0 0.07
scale 0.22 0.2 0.14
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -25 10
add mesh cube --name R2 --size 1 --location 0 -0.02 0.15
scale 0.14 0.14 0.12
apply --scale
set rotation 30 0 40
select R0 R1 R2
material assign Rubble
add mesh cube --name Glow --size 1 --location 0 -0.1 0.05
scale 0.12 0.06 0.08
apply --scale
material assign Ember
select all
shade flat
export rubble.glb
